verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a built-in object storage service. Fly Volumes and per-Sprite persistent disks are block or attached disk storage, an adjacent capability that earns no credit. A community user also reports having to leave Fly to store user assets because it lacked an S3 replacement. The axis applies to a cloud platform, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage
